Our Long-Term Blueprint

Engineering the Infrastructure of Modern, Clean Living

Society’s everyday life depends on reliable infrastructure: smart homes, inverter climate control, heat pumps, rooftop solar grids, and EV charging stations are becoming ubiquitous.

With 8+ years of field engineering excellence across banking, e-surveillance, and energy automation, Wetzel Barron Infosystem (WBI) brings the enterprise discipline and fair remuneration needed to empower the frontline trade workforce.

Elevating Social Standing & Fair Work Charter

Every TazkY partner carries a verifiable QR-coded engineering badge, standardized high-visibility clean uniform, and is backed by a legally binding customer charter that guarantees zero verbal abuse, pre-approved labor terms, and immediate platform support if boundary breaches occur.

✓ Digital Certification ✓ Guaranteed Rest Days ✓ Respectful Customer Protocol
Spearheading the Clean Energy & EV Transition

As millions of households switch to solar inverters, lithium battery walls, and domestic EV wallboxes, traditional mechanics are left behind. TazkY Academy trains every engineer in safe high-voltage DC systems, solar efficiency tuning, and EV charger commissioning at zero tuition cost.

✓ EVSE Installation Certified ✓ Rooftop Solar Micro-Inverters ✓ Low-GWP Eco Refrigerants
Shifting from Reactive Fixes to Predictive Care

Through TazkY IoT sensors and smart appliance integrations, the platform detects compressor wear, pressure drop, or power factor degradation before failure happens. Engineers are dispatched with the exact required spare part in hand, boosting first-time fix rates to 99%.

✓ Zero Guesswork ✓ Pre-Dispatched OEM Parts ✓ Augmented Reality Guidance
Engineer Guild & Long-Term Wealth Creation

Unlike traditional gig platforms where value solely benefits external shareholders, TazkY reserves an equity and profit-share pool for Master Engineers who maintain stellar ratings, train apprentices, and manage regional parts distribution hubs.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about joining, payments, safety, and operational mechanics.

Absolutely zero. Unlike old-style directories or gig portals that sell customer leads to multiple technicians who compete against each other, TazkY charges zero lead buying fees. You receive verified, pre-paid, exclusive work orders. TazkY only takes a small, transparent platform service share (8%–15% depending on your tier) upon successful job completion.
Payouts are deposited directly into your linked bank account or registered UPI ID within 48 hours of the customer entering their completion OTP. If you need cash urgently, active engineers with a 4.8+ rating can enable "Instant Daily Cashout" at zero additional fee.
The TazkY Shield is a tripartite welfare safety net: (1) Cashless accidental emergency hospitalization cover up to ₹5,00,000; (2) Family medical cashless cover up to ₹2,00,000 for active engineers; and (3) Tool loss & transit damage protection up to ₹50,000. Premium costs are fully sponsored by TazkY.
You only need your standard basic hand tools to start. For specialized equipment (such as digital manifold gauges, PCB circuit testers, thermal cameras, and vacuum pumps), TazkY provides a 0% interest Tool Financing Credit Line. Equipment is delivered to you on day one, and small affordable repayments are seamlessly deducted from your earnings over 6 months.
All replacement parts are sourced directly from authorized manufacturers (OEMs) through our physical TazkY & WBI Hubs, backed by official brand warranty. You procure parts at wholesale trade discounts, and TazkY gives you a transparent 10% to 15% spare parts handling incentive directly in your settlement.
Yes! You have total control over your schedule. Through the app toggle, you can switch your availability "Online" or "Offline" at any moment. Many engineers work full-time (5-6 days/week), while others operate as weekend specialists earning supplemental income during peak Saturday/Sunday demand.

TazkY & WBI Fair Work Charter and Conduct Code

The terms every TazkY Service Engineer and WBI agree to before the first job.

1. What WBI commits to

  • Fast, direct pay. Job earnings are released to your bank or UPI within 48 hours of verified completion.
  • Pre-paid orders. Customers pay before the visit, so there is no price haggling at the door and no chasing payments.
  • Transparent rate cards. Rates, parts margins and bonuses are published in the app before you accept a job.
  • No lead fees. You are never charged to receive or accept a job.
  • Respect on every job. Zero tolerance for verbal abuse or harassment of engineers, by customers or staff.
  • Protection. Health and tool cover through the TazkY Shield, as described on this page.
  • Fair hearing. Ratings, deductions and suspensions can be disputed with the independent engineer safety tribunal.

2. What engineers commit to

  • Arrive within the booked window, wear the TazkY uniform and carry your QR-coded engineering badge.
  • Confirm the customer's job OTP before starting work and close the job in the app when finished.
  • Diagnose honestly. Recommend only the repairs and parts the fault needs, and use genuine parts.
  • Keep all payments inside the platform. Do not take cash or ask for off-app payments.
  • Follow electrical, working-at-height and equipment safety practice on every site.
  • Treat customers, colleagues and WBI staff with courtesy, and keep customer data and premises private.
  • Provide accurate details and valid identity and qualification documents, and update them if they change.

3. Conduct that ends the partnership

Fraud, falsified documents, theft, abuse, working under the influence, repeated no-shows, or taking customers off the platform can lead to suspension or removal after review by the tribunal. Safety incidents are reviewed first and fastest.

4. Your data

WBI uses your contact details, documents and job telemetry only to run the TazkY service and keep it safe. It is encrypted in transit and is not shared with third-party telemarketers.
